# Quotes script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## quotes.add

Saves a new quote. It gets the next number. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action. Fails when the text is empty.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `text` | The quote, like "I never miss a jump." |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. Who said it, like "CoolStreamer". Leave it out for the user of the trigger. |
| `userId` | `user_id` | Optional. That person's user id. Leave it out for the id of the trigger's user. |
| `platform` | `platform` | Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger. |
| `game` | `game` | Optional. The game, like "Celeste". Leave it out for the game Cuebot last saw you stream. |

**Gives back:** The new quote, with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.add", new { text = "I never miss a jump.", user = "CoolStreamer" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_add(text="I never miss a jump.", user="CoolStreamer")
    ```

## quotes.count

Counts your saved quotes.

**Gives back:** The number of quotes.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.count");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_count()
    ```

## quotes.delete

Deletes a quote.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `id` | The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too). |

**Gives back:** true when it existed, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.delete", new { id = 12 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_delete(id=12)
    ```

## quotes.edit

Changes a quote. Only what you pass is changed; the rest stays.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `id` | The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too). |
| `text` | `text` | Optional. The new quote text. |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. The new name of who said it. |
| `game` | `game` | Optional. The new game. |

**Gives back:** The changed quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when there is no such quote.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.edit", new { id = 12, game = "Celeste" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_edit(id=12, game="Celeste")
    ```

## quotes.get

Gets one quote by its number.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `id` | The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too). |

**Gives back:** An object with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt. null when there is no such quote.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.get", new { id = 12 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_get(id=12)
    ```

## quotes.random

Picks a random quote. Can pick only among quotes that contain a word, and can fire the Quote shown trigger.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | `search` | Optional. Only quotes whose text, user or game contains this, like "jump". A number also matches that quote id. |
| `show` | `show` | Optional. true also runs your Quote shown trigger with the picked quote. Leave it out for false. |

**Gives back:** The quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when none match.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.random", new { search = "jump", show = true });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_random(search="jump", show=True)
    ```

## quotes.search

Finds quotes whose text, user or game contains a word. Upper or lower case does not matter.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `query` | What to look for, like "jump". Leave it empty for every quote. |

**Gives back:** A list of quotes, each with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.search", new { query = "jump" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_search(query="jump")
    ```

## quotes.show

Runs your Quote shown trigger for a quote, so an overlay or action can display it.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `id` | The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too). |

**Gives back:** The quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when there is no such quote.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("quotes.show", new { id = 12 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.quotes_show(id=12)
    ```
